name: Apollo 11
elevationProduct: LOLA LDEM_16 (16 px/degree, NASA CGI Moon Kit tiles)
note: Tranquility Base, 20 July 1969. Equatorial contrast: the Sun rises and sets once a month, high in the sky. Horizon is a smooth sphere.
source: LROC, Coordinates of Lunar Anthropogenic Targets, 28 July 2016, Apollo 11 LM; Wagner et al. 2017, Icarus 283, 92-103 (https://lroc.im-ldi.com/data/support/downloads/2016_LROC_Coordinates_of_Human_Features.pdf)
frameEvidence: LROC states the mean Earth/polar axis (ME) system; DE421 is the ME realization the LRO project uses (Barker et al. 2021).
summary: First crewed Moon landing, in Mare Tranquillitatis.
